description: Halal restaurants near a city or coordinates, nearest first, with each one's CHDA halal assurance code in words (who stands behind the halal status, the kitchen, alcohol), cuisines, HalalTrip Gastronomy Awards and its HalalTrip page.

halal.description: Only restaurants with a halal certificate, or certified or Muslim-owned. Default any.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

limit.description: How many places, 1 to 10, nearest first. Default 5.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

radius_km.description: How far to look, in km (1 to 25). Default 5.

name: find_halal_restaurants
title: Halal restaurants nearby
